title: NumPy: Arrays and Vectorized Computation

lessons.title: Vectorized Operations

Use elementwise math and aggregation functions

lessons.title: Broadcasting and Boolean Indexing
lessons.description: Combine differently-shaped arrays and filter data without loops.
